    apply hPP U hU V hV

        rw [hAV] at hx

have h_cover (A : Set S) : A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    by_contra! h
    rcases h_disjoint A h.1 with ⟨U, hU, hAU⟩
    rcases h_disjoint Aᶜ h.2 with ⟨V, hV, hAV⟩
    apply hPP U hU V hV
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hxU, hxV⟩
      have hxA : x ∈ A := by
        by_contra hxA
        have hx : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := ⟨by simpa, hxV⟩
        rw [hAV] at hx
        exact hx
      have hx : x ∈ A ∩ U := ⟨hxA, hxU⟩
      rw [hAU] at hx
      exact hx
    · simp
